title: PATCH to /dns_settings with foundation_dns is rejected and the field disappears from responses
symptoms: PATCH request to /zones/{zone_id}/dns_settings containing foundation_dns is rejected
foundation_dns missing from GET responses for zone settings or account defaults
client code reading foundation_dns gets undefined
cause: Starting 2026-11-23, with a rollout of about seven days, the DNS settings endpoints for zones and account defaults no longer return or accept the deprecated foundation_dns boolean. Advanced Nameservers are now configured only through nameservers.type.
fix: Stop reading and writing foundation_dns. Set nameservers.type to cloudflare.advanced instead. Your Foundation DNS subscription and zone state are not changed.
affected: /zones/{zone_id}/dns_settings and /accounts/{account_id}/dns_settings from 2026-11-23, rolling out over about 7 days
